containers.name: prod
containers.description: Root of the prod HDFS environment.

containers.name: raw
containers.description: Raw zone: straight from FTP, no transform.

containers.name: dv_raw
containers.description: DV (data vendor) source files, shared category folder covering more than just deposit account data (e.g. a sibling loan account information file is referenced in this pipeline's source doc) -- not exclusive to dv_deposit_account.

containers.name: deposit_account_information_raw
containers.description: Raw copy of MYMO_DEPOSIT_YYYYMMDD.TXT straight from FTP, before validation. Files land under a daily YYYYMMDD subfolder.

columns.name: row_type
columns.description: H (header), D (detail), or T (tail) -- HDT file format marker

columns.name: ending_balance
columns.description: Numeric value stored as string, e.g. 30000.000000

columns.name: account_group
columns.description: DDA, SAV, or CD. Corrected from the source doc's stated Decimal type -- see draft notes.

columns.name: account_number
columns.description: PII -- hashed with MD5 downstream in the safe Hive table.

columns.name: co_owner
columns.description: Comma-separated CIFs of joint-account co-owners, e.g. 22222,3333

columns.name: relationship_code
columns.description: A = single, B = or, C = and

containers.name: dv_cleansed
containers.description: DV (data vendor) source files, shared category folder -- not exclusive to dv_deposit_account.

containers.name: deposit_account_information_cleansed
